rationale: The mission brief attributes a generator seizing on Day 4 to a long-overdue oil change and recommends including an oil filter in the pre-mission spare parts kit. The crew's own report (FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 08-07-2024) says a dirty air filter was the confirmed cause and the oil was replaced at the same time.
